messages.subject: Rename in shinyServer statement
parts:
I'm getting this error.  Without the input$horizon parts I can get the code to run.  If I don't use the rename, the code runs in shinyServer.

The additional library statements are necessary for the real purpose of this code that will be added back when I can get by this rename issue.

Thanks in advance,
Alan


Arguments to rename must be unquoted variable names. Arguments pl are not.

#==============================
library(dygraphs)
library(xts)
library(devtools)
library(dplyr)
library(haven)

pl <- read_sas('C:/SASVM/CME/Extract/pl.sas7bdat')



shinyServer(function(input, output) { 
  
    
    filterdata <- subset(pl, counterparty=="ALL" &
                           commodity=="ALL" &
                           trader=="ALL" &
                           region=="ALL" &
                           fwdmonth==9999)
 
                   plt <- reactive({ 
                              plotone <- filterdata[,c('AsOfDate', c(input$horizon))  ]
                             plotone <- rename(plotone, pl=input$horizon)
                                })

 output$mytable <- renderTable({plt()})   

})

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Rename in shinyServer statement
parts:
Use rename_ instead of rename and it should work.

rename uses non-standard evaluation which is more convenient until you have indirection like this (i.e. "input$horizon" is not the actual name; the value of input$horizon is the name). rename_ uses standard evaluation for just this reason.
